Refactoring committed. Here's a summary of what was improved across 10 files:

**`StreamTypeUtil.kt`** — Fixed incorrect KDoc on `isAudio` and `isVideo` (both said "is a livestream"); used `in setOf(...)` for cleaner membership checks.

**`ServiceHelper.kt`** — Replaced Java Streams API (`stream().filter().findFirst().map().orElse()`) with Kotlin idioms (`firstOrNull()?.serviceInfo?.name ?: "<unknown>"`); simplified `getServiceById` to `first { ... }`.

**`ErrorUtil.kt`** — Converted from `class { companion object { ... } }` to a flat `object`, removing unnecessary nesting. Also used `apply` in `getErrorActivityIntent` for fluent Intent construction.

**`App.kt`** — Replaced the anonymous `Consumer<Throwable>` object with a Kotlin lambda; extracted helper logic as local functions inside `configureRxJavaErrorHandler`; added null-safe `?.` on `uncaughtExceptionHandler`; removed the unused `Consumer` import; fixed `javaClass.getName()` → `javaClass.name`.

**`NewPipeDatabase.kt`** — Replaced verbose double-checked locking in `getInstance` with an Elvis operator idiom; simplified `close` using `?.let`.

**`Bundle.kt`** — Replaced `StringBuilder` with `buildString`.

**`NewVersionWorker.kt`** — Used `apply` for Intent flag setting.

**`ErrorInfo.kt`** — Replaced `!reason.isEmpty()` with `reason.isNotEmpty()`.

**`PeertubeHelper.kt`** — Used method chaining on `JsonWriter` instead of a separate variable.

**`TextView.kt`** — Replaced Java-style string concatenation with Kotlin string templates.
